command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0092/probe.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: The four 0.63.0 rows: the absolute SIB = 25 shape behind 0x67 at the 32-bit value width, in both directions and both value windows. The bare rows are eight bytes (67 at byte 0, opcode at byte 1, ModRM 04 at byte 2, SIB 25 at byte 3, disp32 at [32,32]); the REX.R rows are nine, with the REX byte at position 1 moving every later field eight bits (value [27,3], disp32 at [40,32]). SIB = 25 is template content, so there is no base, index or scale role and no REX.B/REX.X bit. The displacement is four bytes at every value, including zero (67 8b 04 25 00 00 00 00); the signed ends are 67 8b 04 25 00 00 00 80 and 67 8b 04 25 ff ff ff 7f. %r15d moves ModRM.reg to 3c (67 44 8b 3c 25 34 12 00 00). input_sha256 is probe.asm; output_sha256 is the 84-byte .text.
